    // # Solid analysis
    //
    // Assembling, loading and solving an `ElasticModel3D`. Loads are resolved
    // into `DofLoad` contributions first and summed once at the end, which keeps
    // "which degrees of freedom does this load touch" separate from "add it up"
    // and makes each load kind an independent pure function.

    DofCount(model: ElasticModel3D): Integer
